panels.description: In an old monitoring station, Alex and B11 stand with Mera before a sealed archive door. Leave upper space.
Mera opens the archive; her old override request is rejected on a physical display. Keep the display clear for lettering.
The archive lists travel restriction, financial restriction and pursuit active. Leave the status field unobstructed.
Mera's hand leaves the control while Alex watches. Reserve upper space for her line.
